title: Sciel - Expedition 33 Character Guide & Lore
description: Sciel in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - who they are, when they join the party, their unique mechanic, relationships and role in the story.

sections.title: Who They Are
sections.content:
Sciel joins at Gestral Village and is the party's area-damage dealer. She is at her strongest once she reaches Twilight, which her Foretell stacking builds toward.

Joins: Mid-game (Gestral Village)

sections.title: Background
sections.content: (not documented in verifiable sources) published backstory detail.

sections.title: Playable or NPC
sections.content:
Their defining mechanic is Foretell / Twilight.

Party role: AoE DPS.

In the party tier list they sit at A.
